region: Sri Lanka — Primary: Anuradhapura Lowland DL1b; Secondary: Matale Upland IL1a

sources.notes: Demo screening proxy: FAO Table 14 gives 450-700 mm over the total growing period for paddy rice; 575 mm is the midpoint. This is crop water need, not gross irrigation demand. Puddling, saturation, seepage, percolation, conveyance loss, effective rainfall, and field efficiency remain excluded and unknown.

Sri Lanka DOA RRDI lists recommended varieties by 2.5- to 6-month maturity groups, including Bg 300, Bg 352 and Bg 358. No universal Yala water cutoff or field drainage conclusion is inferred from this page.
Demo screening proxy: FAO Table 14 gives 300-500 mm for bean; 400 mm is the midpoint used provisionally for mung bean. It is not a Sri Lankan cultivar measurement.
Sri Lanka DOA publishes Green Gram crop calendars for Dry and Intermediate zones. Exact duration, irrigation count and waterlogging thresholds are not inferred here.
FAO Table 14 gives an indicative 500-800 mm total-growing-period crop-water range for maize; 650 mm is the midpoint. No yield prediction is made.
Sri Lanka DOA publishes maize crop calendars for Dry and Intermediate zones. Variety duration and drainage prohibitions are not inferred by the screening engine.
FAO Table 14 gives an indicative 500-700 mm total-growing-period crop-water range for peanut/groundnut; 600 mm is the midpoint.
Sri Lanka DOA publishes a Groundnut calendar for Intermediate and Dry zones. Soil-specific prohibitions are not inferred without farmer-entered drainage information.
Demo screening proxy: FAO Table 14 gives 300-500 mm for bean; 400 mm is the midpoint used provisionally for cowpea.
Sri Lanka DOA publishes Cowpea crop calendars. Numeric nitrogen or yield benefits are not assigned.
Demo screening proxy: FAO Table 14 gives 450-650 mm for sorghum/millet; 550 mm is the midpoint used provisionally for finger millet.
Sri Lanka DOA describes finger millet for rain-fed Dry/Intermediate-zone uplands and Yala lowland cultivation only when waterlogging is prevented. The engine does not infer drainage from coordinates.
Demo screening proxy: FAO Table 14 gives 300-500 mm for bean; 400 mm is the midpoint used provisionally for black gram. No numeric nitrogen benefit is assigned.
Sri Lanka DOA publishes Black Gram crop calendars for Dry and Intermediate zones. Exact duration and saturation thresholds are not inferred here.
Demo screening proxy: FAO Table 14 gives 600-900 mm for pepper; 750 mm is the midpoint used provisionally for chilli. No yield or waterlogging-time claim is made.
Sri Lanka DOA publishes Chilli crop calendars. No universal Solanaceae exclusion, yield claim or exact duration is enforced by this catalog.
